description: Design-build contractor on an encapsulated mass timber residential building, eight storeys. In the top-floor suites the developer wants the CLT ceilings left fully exposed, about 60% of each suite's ceiling, with a clear intumescent coating. Walls would stay covered with gypsum.

gold.departure: Exposed mass timber ceiling area far beyond the permitted percentage, encapsulation replaced by a coating.

should_cite.why: limits on exposed mass timber ceilings within a suite

must_not_cite.why: 60% exceeds both limits in that sentence

gold.engineering_reason: Eight-storey building is outside the exemption.
